Bihar ke betiya men senko gold end daymand shorum men dinadhare karoron ki lut ne pure bihar ko hilakar rakh diya hai. aath apradhiyon ne aisi shatir planing ke sath is vardat ko anjam diya ki pulis bhi hairan hai.janie lut ki andar ki kahani
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
